text:
Subject: Upcoming Office Move - Important Details and Next Steps

Hi Team,

I am writing to inform you that our office will be moving to a new location next month. This move is part of our strategy to provide a more collaborative and efficient workspace for everyone.

**New Address:**
123 Innovation Drive, Suite 400
Tech City, TC 90210

**Important Moving Dates:**
- **Packing Deadline:** All personal items must be packed and labeled by Friday, October 20th.
- **Last Day at Current Office:** Friday, October 27th.
- **First Day at New Office:** Monday, October 30th.

**Your Responsibilities:**
During the transition, please ensure the following:
1. Pack all personal belongings, including photos, books, and non-company items, into the provided boxes.
2. Label each box clearly with your name and the destination room in the new office.
3. Disconnect all computer equipment and peripherals by the end of the day on October 27th.
4. Leave your desk clean and clear of any items that are not packed.

IT will be available on October 28th and 29th to assist with the setup of your workstations at the new location. If you have any questions or need additional packing materials, please reach out to the facilities team.

Thank you for your cooperation in making this move smooth and successful.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Office Manager
